T:P2.1.text: About Us | American Financial Group, Inc.

T:P2.2.text: American Financial Group, Inc. is a holding company based in Cincinnati, Ohio and. Our insurance roots go back to 1872 with the founding of Great American Insurance Company. Today, through the operations of Great American Insurance Group, AFG is engaged in property and casualty (P&C) insurance, focusing on specialized commercial products for businesses. We are proud to provide insurance products that help businesses manage their unique financial risks and exposures.

T:P2.3.text: AFG’s Specialty P&C Group is comprised of over 35 diversified businesses offering a wide range of specialty commercial coverages in three major groupings: Property and Transportation, Specialty Casualty and Specialty Financial.

T:P2.4.text: Many of our businesses are among the top performers in their respective industries. Our business has entrepreneurial spirit at its core, with a focus on accountability. Business autonomy in our Specialty P&C operations facilitates agility in underwriting, claims and policy servicing, and enables these businesses to develop distribution strategies and relationships in the unique markets they serve.

T:P2.5.text: By following a consistent, opportunistic strategy over many years and changing economic conditions, we have outperformed market indices over the long term while effectively managing portfolio risk.

T:P2.6.text: With the power of generations behind it, AFG grows and changes with discipline and integrity. We're proud of who we are, where we've been and where we're going. Our industry is changing, and we continue to change as well.

T:P2.7.text: American Financial Group traces its history to 1959. In the early days, the Company was known as American Financial Corporation. At its inception, the Company’s principal business consisted of savings and loans. C:P1.1.text: Boston Omaha Corporation — Diversified Public Holding Company

C:P1.2.text: Boston Omaha Corporation, is a public holding company with four businesses: Broadband, Billboards, Bonds and Boston Omaha Asset Management.

C:P1.3.text: Boston Omaha Corporation, is a public holding company with four businesses: Broadband (telecommunications services), Billboards (outdoor advertising), Bonds (surety insurance) and Asset Management.

C:P2.2.text: Challenging the Way We Look at the Insurance Business

C:P2.3.text: General Indemnity Group (GIG) is an insurance holding company. The company specializes in acquiring and operating companies that underwrite and distribute insurance products.

C:P2.4.text: The innovative GIG team grows businesses by building digital, online offerings and modernizing outdated systems and workflows. They transform paper processes and methods of the past into more efficient digital and automated routines. Their expertise in data visualization, systems engineering, software design, product management, IT and HR is exceptional.

C:P2.5.text: Since its incorporation in, GIG has acquired five surety-only agencies, as well as an A- Excellent” (AM Best rating) monoline surety insurance company., United Casualty and Surety. United Casualty & Surety is licensed to write surety policies in all 50 states, and is approved by the United States Department of the Treasury (Dept. Circular 570) to bond federal projects throughout the United States.

C:P3.4.text: Built on a Dream to Provide the Internet to the Underserved

C:P3.5.text: AireBeam is one of Arizona’s fastest growing fiber-to-home and fixed wireless internet service providers. The company successfully delivers affordable, accessible internet access and innovative solutions to rural communities across state.

C:P3.6.text: AireBeam was born from a need the company founders observed. Rural Arizona residents themselves, they noted a lack of access to reliable internet service in the area. In fact, most of the population couldn’t even handle small, day-to-day tasks via the internet.

C:P3.7.text: AireBeam is now a determined force for change in their local communities. They believe everyone should have access to fast, reliable internet service, especially the underserved.

C:P3.9.text: This alliance allows them to plan for additional Fiber-to-Home projects and expand services to not only consumers, but also to home builders, developers, build-to-rent communities, RV parks and others.

C:P3.10.text: Fiber-Fast Internet for New Homes and Build-to-Rent Communities

C:P3.11.text: Fiber Fast Homes, a Fiber-to-the-Home internet service company, delivers new home communities and build-to-rent communities with reliable, high-speed fiber internet services at Gig speeds.

C:P3.12.text: Today, new home buyers expect fast internet service that can handle the high-bandwidth demands of their smart homes, smart phones, home offices, communication and entertainment needs. Fiber Fast Homes manages that with their best-in-class technology and an elevated level of customer support.
